item.title: From Nurse whistleblower to functional medicine nurse

item.title: Utah State school board member urges parents to flee public schools
item.description: The Dean’s List with Host Dean Bowen – A Utah State School Board member urges parents to withdraw their children from public schools, citing dysfunction, ideological indoctrination, and declining academic performance.
